items.title: Derivation of First Equation of Motion By Graphical Method (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Derivation of First Equation of Motion By Graphical Method: a main subheading of 2.4 Equations of motion, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 28-28.

blocks.text: Pehli equation velocity-time graph se bhi nikal sakte hain, jab cheez initial velocity vi, final velocity vf aur constant acceleration a se chal rahi ho.
Graph par point A par velocity vi hai jo time t mein point B par vf ho jati hai (Fig. 2.5). B se x-axis par perpendicular BD aur y-axis par perpendicular BE banayein. Is tarah:

blocks.latex: OA = v_i = \text{Initial velocity of the body}
blocks.text_alt: OA = vi = Initial velocity of the body

blocks.latex: BD = v_f = \text{Final velocity of the body}
blocks.text_alt: BD = vf = Final velocity of the body

blocks.alt: Velocity-time graph. Seedhi line AB velocity axis ke point A (OA = vi) se B (BD = vf) tak charhti hai. Dashed lines E se B, A se C (length t) aur B se C ke raste time axis par D tak; BD ke saath double arrow vf dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.5: Velocity-time graph (kitab ki Figure 2.5 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: BC ki value line AB ke slope (dhalaan) se milti hai, aur v-t graph ka slope acceleration a hota hai:
Yahi pehli equation of motion hai.
